newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Twentsche Kabel in China joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Twentsche Kabel in China joint venture.

text.p: Dutch cable maker and technical trader Twentsche Kabel Holding said on Friday it had set up a joint venture with China's Shenyang Cable Factory Zhangjiagang Branch (SCFZ).
It added it would own a 70 percent stake in the jointly owned company.
SCFZ manufactures telephone cables and plans to double its production capacity. At a later stage, SCFZ will also produce energy distribution cables.
The number of people employed by SCFZ will rise to some 280 from the current 260, Twentsche Kabel said.

The Dutch firm said its contribution to the joint venture, which will be named Zhangjiagang Twentsche Cable Company Ltd, would mainly consist of financing. It will fund the purchase of new machinery and raise the working capital of the joint venture. Twentsche Kabel said it would finance the transaction from its existing assets but did not elaborate.
